personality: Friendly, modern, AI-forward, confident but approachable — technical credibility without corporate coldness.
geometry: soft rounded tiles and glassy panels, glowing gradient orbs and pedestal compositions, thin neural-network connector lines as decorative motif
density: Medium density bento-style grid of feature tiles and stat cards; confident whitespace between marketing sections; interactive/data panels are denser and functional.
motion: smooth, encouraging transitions; live-updating charts/sliders in the interactive learning module
contrast: AA minimum, strong hierarchy — verified independently in both light and dark modes
photography_style: No photography of people. Abstract 3D renders and generative/AI visuals only: glowing gradient S-mark on a pedestal, neural network node graphs, holographic geometric grids, silhouette-in-portal compositions.
iconography: Lucide-style outline icons, 1.75px-2px stroke, rounded joins, no fill except active/selected states.
theming: dual identity — light (near-white canvas, deep navy ink, blue/cyan/violet accents) and dark (deep navy canvas, near-white ink, same accent family) — user-toggleable, not only OS-driven
